reasoning: Both reviews cover most of the rubric well. B wins on the most harmful issue: it rates the blocking join modal Critical and keeps the popup closed on join, while A rates it Medium and still auto-opens. B also covers TextScaled ignoring the player's text size setting and adds TopbarInset handling. B's leftover template text and possibly false ResetOnSpawn finding cost it on usability, but they don't outweigh its better prioritisation and coverage.

#4 (Critical) flags the off-platform link at Hud.luau:144 and recommends removing it, pointing to Social Links instead.
#7 moves the menu off the jump button to mid-right; #8 covers IgnoreGuiInset = true with the coins at (8, 8) and fixes it with CoreUISafeInsets.
Covers Activated, SelectedObject, ButtonB through ContextActionService, hover-only tooltips, and TouchEnabled → PreferredInput (#18).
#9 gives concrete target sizes; #15 flags TextScaled shrinking but never mentions that it ignores the player's text size setting.
Contrast table (2.6:1), grey-only tiles with a check-mark fix, endless pulse (#14), and the 1.5 s toast (#17).
Clean summary table, severity levels, and a fix order with line references and API names; code is untouched.
C2 (Critical) recommends source(false) plus a badge and a toast, and never auto-opening in the first minutes.
C3 removes the countdown and the threat, cites ICO Standard 13 and WCAG 2.2.1, and adds a grace day.
C1 quotes the Community Standards on external URLs and deletes the label in favour of Social Links.
H2 covers the menu on the jump button and the coins under the top bar, with CoreUISafeInsets and live TopbarInset.
C4 covers Activated, GuiService:Select, SelectionGroup and B to close; H4 covers hover-only tooltips; H2 covers TouchEnabled → PreferredInput.
H3 gives the 10 mm/44 px minimum with a larger primary action; M3 says TextScaled ignores PreferredTextSize and gives inconsistent sizes.
H7 contrast table and colour-only day states, H5 pulse plus ReducedMotionEnabled, M2 toast too short.
Ordered by harm with good fixes, but it leaks <skill> placeholders and internal principle/step references, and H1 (ResetOnSpawn) may be false if the ScreenGui is created with Vide create.

strengths: Clean, professional document with a summary table and a fix order
Extra useful finding: no block hotbar for touch and gamepad
weaknesses: Rates the blocking join modal only Medium and still auto-opens it
Doesn't say TextScaled ignores the player's preferred text size

strengths: Treats the join flow as Critical with a play-first fix
Thorough engine API use (TopbarInset, PreferredInput, ReducedMotionEnabled, PreferredTextSize)
